import 'dart:io';

/// The sum of [sizes].
int total(List<int> sizes) {
  var sum = 0;
  for (final size in sizes) {
    sum += size;
  }
  return sum;
}

/// How many jobs wait in the directory [path]: its files, without what is
/// not yet unpacked (`.part`). None in a directory that is not there.
int waiting(String path) {
  final folder = Directory(path);
  if (!folder.existsSync()) {
    return 0;
  }
  var count = 0;
  for (final entity in folder.listSync()) {
    if (entity.path.endsWith('.part')) {
      continue;
    }
    count++;
  }
  return count;
}
